from pathlib import Path
program_dir=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-high-ws0/frozen/held-out-4/play/users/u028/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
program_path=program_dir/'task-62aa0edc.py'
source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    frame = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 5]
    top, bottom = min(r for r, c in frame), max(r for r, c in frame)
    left, right = min(c for r, c in frame), max(c for r, c in frame)
    mid_r, mid_c = (top + bottom) / 2, (left + right) / 2
    inside_r0, inside_r1 = top + 1, bottom
    inside_c0, inside_c1 = left + 1, right
    row_mid = (inside_r0 + inside_r1) // 2
    col_mid = (inside_c0 + inside_c1) // 2
    markers = [(r, c, v) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row)
               if v not in (0, 5)]
    for r, c, color in markers:
        is_top = r < mid_r
        is_left = c < mid_c
        r0, r1 = (inside_r0, row_mid) if is_top else (row_mid, inside_r1)
        c0, c1 = (inside_c0, col_mid) if is_left else (col_mid, inside_c1)
        for rr in range(r0, r1):
            for cc in range(c0, c1):
                out[rr][cc] = color
        # The color is repeated in the diagonally opposite quadrant.
        r0, r1 = (row_mid, inside_r1) if is_top else (inside_r0, row_mid)
        c0, c1 = (col_mid, inside_c1) if is_left else (inside_c0, col_mid)
        for rr in range(r0, r1):
            for cc in range(c0, c1):
                out[rr][cc] = color
    return out
'''
program_path.write_text(source)
import importlib.util
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('task_transform', program_path)
mod=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(mod)

    for c in (5,6): expected[r][c]=4
